description: Find US BJJ gyms, drop-ins, and class times.
name: OpenMapp

tools.name: find_gyms
tools.title: Find BJJ gyms
tools.description: Find BJJ gyms near a US city, neighborhood, or ZIP. Defaults match the OpenMapp map: open to drop-ins, classes today. Returns drop-in policy, visitor fee when known, and matching class times.

q.description: City, neighborhood, address, or ZIP, same as the OpenMapp search box

drop_ins.description: Only gyms marked Drop-ins (known welcome or a listed visitor/open-mat price). Default true

today.description: Only gyms with a listed class or open mat today. Default true

kinds.description: Filter to Gi, No-Gi, and/or open mat

day.description: Restrict to this weekday or tomorrow. Overrides today

tools.name: get_gym
tools.title: Get gym details
tools.description: Full public gym card: address, drop-in policy, visitor fee, and the weekly timetable. Use an id or slug from find_gyms.

id.description: Gym id or slug from find_gyms, e.g. 10th-planet-allentown

tools.name: list_cities
tools.title: List covered cities
tools.description: US cities OpenMapp covers, with gym counts, how many welcome class drop-ins, and how many list an open mat. Use this to check coverage before find_gyms. Filter by city name or two-letter state.

q.description: Filter by city name, e.g. Austin

limit.description: Max cities to return. Default all matching, max 500

tools.name: map_url
tools.title: OpenMapp map link
tools.description: OpenMapp map link for a city search, optionally with a gym drawer already open.

q.description: City or search text for the map search box

gym_id.description: Gym id from find_gyms to open the details drawer
